t: Look up at the side of the old St George's Town Hall and you'll see the Cable Street Mural, a huge painting of the Battle of Cable Street in 1936. It was painted between 1979 and 1983. Dave Binnington drew the original design, and he worked with Paul Butler, Ray Walker and Desmond Rochfort. Ray Walker was among the most prominent of the political and community muralists active in London in the 1970s and 80s. The woodworker and writer David Savage is also credited with a hand in it. It's a picture made by and for the neighbourhood.
